style: Hand-painted game art for an arcane academy, painterly rather than photoreal, muted desaturated colour, dark values, crisp readable shapes
texture_rules: Draw it as a flat top-down seamless texture, orthographic straight-down view with no perspective and no horizon, evenly lit with no cast shadows and no vignette. The material fills the whole frame as one repeating surface: no separate objects, props, symbols, letters or drawings on it. Keep the pattern coarse, roughly six repeats across the frame, so it stays legible when the tile is shown 64 pixels wide.
cutout_rules: A single object alone and centred on a plain flat mid-grey backdrop, lit evenly from above with no cast shadow, drawn in full with nothing cropped. Simple bold shapes and a strong silhouette that still reads when shrunk to 48 pixels tall. No ground, no room, no other objects, no text.

tiles.floor_hall: A flat top-down surface of worn grey flagstone corridor paving, four or five big irregular slabs, faint chalk ward marks
tiles.floor_lecture_hall: A flat top-down surface of dark warm brown polished oak floorboards, straight parallel planks, subtle grain
tiles.floor_alchemy: A flat top-down surface of stained dark slate laboratory paving, a few large tiles, pale etched blotches
tiles.floor_scriptorium: A flat top-down surface of deep crimson patterned scriptorium carpet with a bold muted gold geometric motif
tiles.floor_refectory: A flat top-down surface of scrubbed pale grey refectory flagstones, a few large worn slabs
tiles.floor_training_yard: A flat top-down surface of packed tan sand and dirt of a training yard, raked lines and scattered pebbles
tiles.floor_reliquary: A flat top-down surface of cold grey granite paving with a bold brass inlay strip across it
tiles.floor_study: A flat top-down surface of dark green study carpet with a subtle woven pattern
tiles.floor_stairs: A flight of stone steps descending into a shaft below the floor, seen from directly above, every tread washed in bright cyan arcane light rising from the shaft with near-black risers between them, so the tile is mostly glowing blue

props.desk: a plain wooden writing desk of an arcane academy
props.brazier: a lit iron brazier on a tripod, coals glowing warm
props.podium: a carved wooden reading podium with an open book on it
props.rune_slate: a dark slate lecture board on a stand, glowing blue runes on its face
props.reliquary: a closed warded oak chest bound in iron, a glowing arcane seal across the lid
props.reliquary_looted: an open empty oak chest bound in iron, its arcane seal dark and broken
props.bookshelf: a tall bookshelf crammed with grimoires and rolled scrolls

entities.player: a young apprentice in a patched blue-grey robe with a satchel of scrolls, chalk-dusted hands, determined
entities.novice: a nervous first-year novice in a plain undyed robe clutching an oversized grimoire
entities.battle_chanter: a broad-shouldered battle chanter in reinforced crimson robes, a shield strapped to one arm
entities.disputation_adept: a thin disputation adept in violet scholar robes with a hovering quill and open ledger
entities.illusionist: a theatrical illusionist in teal robes wearing a mirrored mask, a faint duplicate afterimage
entities.proctor: a corridor proctor in amber uniform robes with a brass badge, carrying a ledger and a spike
entities.senior_warden: a senior warden in ornate orange and gold robes with a warding horn at the belt
entities.visiting_lecturer: a severe visiting lecturer in purple academic robes holding a red quill
entities.alchemy_master: an alchemy master in stained deep purple robes with a bandolier of flasks and goggles
entities.drillmaster: a scarred yard drillmaster in dark red training leathers swinging bound stones on a rope
entities.vice_chancellor: an imposing vice-chancellor in heavy violet ceremonial robes carrying a great ledger
entities.rector: the Rector, a towering figure in deep indigo and gold robes beneath a crown of floating runes

rules.floor_stairs: Orthographic straight-down view with no perspective. One staircase only, centred and filling the frame, the treads as four or five bold parallel bands of glowing cyan alternating with near-black, unmistakable at 64 pixels wide. Cyan and blue dominate the whole image. Almost no fine detail, no grey stone border, no railings, no cast shadows, no vignette, no people, no text.
rules.door_closed_face: Draw it straight on as a flat front elevation, orthographic with no perspective and no floor, the subject filling the frame edge to edge. Bold simple shapes and almost no fine detail, because this is shown about 30 pixels across. Evenly lit, no cast shadows, no vignette, no people, no text.
rules.door_open_face: Draw it straight on as a flat front elevation, orthographic with no perspective and no floor, the subject filling the frame edge to edge. Bold simple shapes and almost no fine detail, because this is shown about 30 pixels across. Evenly lit, no cast shadows, no vignette, no people, no text.

block_textures.wall_stone: A flat top-down surface of carved grey granite academy wall blocks with mortar lines
block_textures.door_closed_face: A closed arched oak door with iron banding, set in a carved stone wall
block_textures.door_open_face: An open arched doorway in a carved stone wall, the oak door swung inward, dark passage beyond
